name: liongard-mcp
description: Every Liongard endpoint, plus an offline copy of your whole MSP estate you can join, search, and drift-check from one command.

liongard_api_key.title: LIONGARD_API_KEY
liongard_api_key.description: Required. Base64 X-ROAR-API-KEY for the Liongard API (or set LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_ID + LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET instead).

liongard_endpoints_api_key.title: LIONGARD_ENDPOINTS_API_KEY
liongard_endpoints_api_key.description: Optional. Only needed for the Liongard Endpoints API surface.

liongard_instance.title: LIONGARD_INSTANCE
liongard_instance.description: Required. Your Liongard subdomain (the 'acme' in acme.app.liongard.com); builds the API URL.
